sentences.text: Each extinguishing agent suits certain fires.
Dry chemical, rated A B C or B C, is the most common on boats and works on most fires, but it leaves a corrosive powder.
Carbon dioxide works on fuel and electrical fires by displacing oxygen, leaves no residue, but has short range and can suffocate people in a closed space.
Clean agents are often used in fixed engine-room systems.
Water is excellent for Class A fires, but a solid stream on burning fuel spreads it, and on electrical equipment it conducts electricity.
